items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I saw an interview of the great actor who played in the movie with Dustin Hoffman... I thought it was a great story by Dustin Hoffman

ctx.x: So you have good time. Do you have another gem like that that you could offer me?

Listen. Listen. Listen to the best of the best. And when you’re on the bandstand listen to what’s going on around you. Listen. Listen to — go listen live. Listen to great recordings. Be in it. Be in it cause you dig it, not just because you know. I think I should be a country & western star but I’m not a country & western star. I used to sing country & western but © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

I think I’m going to sing jazz. And if that doesn’t work well I’ll sing pop. And if that doesn’t work maybe I’ll take some classical lessons and I’ll be a tenor. Well then you just want to be on the bandstand. You don’t have a love for a specific kind of music. Or maybe you have a broad love for music, I don’t know. But to me either you have some kind of a taste or a proclivity to do something specific because you dig it. Well I mean I can’t just say, “I think I’ll sing country & western.” Because I won’t be…
